title: Swift Package List Plugin Configuration v1
description: Legacy configuration for SwiftPackageListPlugin. Relative paths are resolved against the project directory. An omitted or null version selects v1.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema used by editors to validate this configuration.

version.description: The configuration format version. Omit, set to null or set to 1 for v1.

projectPath.description: Path to the project or workspace. Defaults to Package.swift for Swift packages or the current .xcodeproj for Xcode projects.

project.description: Options for targets without an explicit entry in targets. Explicit target entries do not inherit these options; omitted or null options use the plugin defaults.

targets.description: Options keyed by exact target name (displayName in Xcode). The '*' key has no wildcard behavior in v1; use project for fallback options.

outputType.description: Format of the output generated in the plugin work directory.

packageOrder.description: The order of packages in the generated output.

requiresLicense.description: Include only packages with a license.

ignorePackages.description: Package identity patterns to exclude from the output. Glob patterns are supported.

customPackagesFilePaths.description: Paths to custom package files to include in the output.
